title: Ottabase app deploy manifest
description: apps/<app>/cloudflare-config.json: how otta deploy builds, checks and ships the app, wherever it runs (a terminal, Cloudflare Workers Builds, GitHub Actions). The one deploy file to edit besides Cloudflare's own wrangler.jsonc, which keeps the Worker name and the bindings. otta deploy reads it strictly: an unknown key or a wrong value stops the deploy and names itself. The defaults below live once in packages/cli/src/commands/deploy-plan.ts; a test holds the two together.

deployable.description: Whether CI deploys the app: otta deploy --all, so Workers Builds and deploy.yml. otta deploy <app> deploys it either way.

previewDeployable.description: Whether PR previews (otta deploy --preview, pr-preview.yml) deploy a copy of the app from its env.preview block.

appType.description: The app's shape; only the hints shown when a build leaves the wrong output depend on it.

buildCommand.description: The app's package.json script that builds it.

workerBuildCommand.description: A second package.json script that turns the build into the Worker bundle (OpenNext for a Next.js app). Null or empty: none.

verifyPaths.description: Paths inside the app that must exist after the build; otta deploy stops before wrangler when one is missing.

wranglerConfig.description: The wrangler config file in the app folder.

wranglerEnv.description: The env block deployed when --env is not given.

healthCheckPath.description: Requested after the deploy: four tries over fifteen seconds, ten seconds each; any answer below 400 passes. A failure is reported, never fatal.

requiresSecrets.description: Build-time values beyond the wrangler.jsonc placeholders (which are found on their own): a source map upload token, a Sentry token. In CI each is checked before the build and handed to the build scripts, and no other value from a CI's secrets is. CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN is always checked outside Workers Builds.
